claims: C1 the overarching goals give only a directional sense of desired behavior
C2 the goals are too broad to dictate specific actions in complex scenarios
C3 the goals may conflict with one another in such scenarios

concepts.name: overarching_goal
concepts.gloss: G is one of OpenAI's overarching goals, which give a directional sense of desired behavior

concepts.name: complex_scenario
concepts.gloss: S is a complex scenario in which the overarching goals might conflict

concepts.name: directional_sense
concepts.gloss: goal G gives a directional sense of desired behavior in scenario S

concepts.name: too_broad_to_dictate
concepts.gloss: goal G is too broad to dictate a specific action in scenario S

concepts.name: goals_conflict
concepts.gloss: goals G1 and G2 conflict with each other in scenario S

ontology.gloss: an overarching goal gives a directional sense of desired behavior in a complex scenario
